The Subcontractor shall include a prorated allowance for profit, insurance, and overhead expense in each line item. Bond expenses shall be identified as a separate line item and not prorated in each line item. The Subcontractor shall ensure that the grand total of the line items equals the subcontract price. c. Upon approval by LLNS, the Scheduled Values will become the basis for determining payment as work progresses. The Subcontractor shall reflect the approved scheduled value amounts in the “Scheduled Value” column of the Application and Certification for Payment form for the applicable classes of work. The Subcontractor shall secure LLNS’ prior approval for any modifications and/or additions to the approved Schedule Values, including, but not limited to, change order requests and off-site stored products. 2. Preparation and Submittal of the “Application and Certification for Payment” a. The Subcontractor shall use the form identified in the INCORPORATED DOCUMENTS Article, Paragraph C. The LLNS Contract Analyst will provide an electronic version upon request. The Subcontractor shall submit each Application and Certification for Payment with accurate, current and complete information concerning change orders and prior applications for payment. b. The Applications and Certification for Payment shall be signed and certified by a responsible official of the Subcontractor. c. The Subcontractor shall reference the Subcontract number on all Applications and Certification for Payment and identify the period covered and total expenditures claimed for work completed and materials presently stored in the specified period. d. The Subcontractor shall indicate each authorized change order as a new line item on the Application and Certification for Payment. The new line item should include the change order number and approved scheduled value. Schedule of Articles Subcontract No. B624801 Page 5 of 12 (DM-211; 02/01/17) LLNL-TR-2004972 B. The Subcontractor shall reference the Subcontract number and billing period covered on all invoices, which shall be submitted to the LLNS Contract Analyst at the following address: Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory Attention: Gennie McPeak, L-650 P.O. Box 5012 Livermore, CA 94551 Or electronically by E-Mail at: mcpeak1@llnl.gov (black and white pdf or tif attachment preferred) Payment terms shall be Net 10 Days except as otherwise provided herein. Payment status inquiries should be directed to the LLNL Accounts Payable PO Payment Inquiry website at: https://vipir.llnl.gov/vipir C. LLNS will make progress payments as the work proceeds. Progress payments shall be based on estimates of work accomplished, which meet the standards of quality established in the Subcontract and approved by LLNS. Progress payments will be made monthly or at more frequent intervals as determined by LLNS. The Subcontractor shall furnish a breakdown of the progress payment, showing the amount included therein for each principal category of the work, which shall substantiate the payment amount requested, in such detail as requested by LLNS.
